newsitem.title: MADAGASCAR: Ethiopians start hunger strike for refugee status.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopians start hunger strike for refugee status.

text.p: A dozen Ethiopians, languishing in Madagascar since 1994, have started a hunger strike to pressure the government into recognising them as refugees.
But the Madagascan government on Tuesday said the Ethiopians came as tourists and did not warrant refugee status.
The Ethiopians began the hunger strike on Monday outside the U.N. Development Programme (UNDP) office in the capital.
"The government doesn't want to recognise us for fear of encouraging other refugees to come," said a refugee leader who declined to be identified.
"We are unable to accept these people as political refugees ... because they came here as tourists and only then demanded refugee status," said foreign minister Evariste Marson.
